stages.title: Seed Preparation & Nursery Sowing
stages.description: Select certified disease-free seeds. Soak seeds for 24 hours, incubate for 48 hours, and sow on raised nursery beds.

stages.title: Transplanting
stages.description: Transplant 20-25 day old seedlings into puddled fields. Maintain a shallow water depth of 2-3 cm.

stages.title: Active Tillering & Top Dressing
stages.description: Apply first top-dressing of Nitrogen (Urea). Perform mechanical weeding and monitor for stem borer.

stages.title: Panicle Initiation & Flowering
stages.description: Ensure standing water depth of 5 cm. Apply phosphorus and potassium. Keep pests monitored.

stages.title: Drainage & Harvesting
stages.description: Drain water 10 days before harvest. Harvest when 85% of panicles turn golden brown and grains are firm.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds at 5 cm depth with 60cm x 20cm spacing. Ensure optimum moisture in soil beds.

stages.title: Seedling Stage & Thinning
stages.description: Thin out weak seedlings. Perform first weeding. Monitor for fall armyworm emergence.

stages.title: Knee-High Stage & Top Dressing
stages.description: Apply urea near the base. Earth up plants to provide support. Apply second irrigation.

stages.title: Tasseling & Silking
stages.description: Maintain constant soil moisture. Avoid drought stress as it directly impacts pollination efficiency.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when grain moisture drops to 20% and husks turn straw-colored.

stages.title: Land Prep & Sowing
stages.description: Broadcast seeds in fine tilth soil. Maintain moisture for germination.

stages.title: Thinning & Weeding
stages.description: Thin plants to keep 10-15 cm spacing. Manual weeding is critical.

stages.title: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Apply top dressing of Nitrogen. Monitor for yellow mites and semilooper.

stages.title: Harvesting & Retting
stages.description: Harvest at small-pod stage. Tie in bundles and submerge in slow-running water for retting (15-20 days).

stages.title: Fiber Extraction
stages.description: Extract fibers from retted stems, wash in clean water, and hang on bamboo frames to dry.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow in ridges. Apply pre-emergence herbicide if weed pressure is high.

stages.title: Squaring Phase
stages.description: Flower buds (squares) begin to appear. Perform weeding and apply first split of nitrogen.

stages.title: Flowering & Boll formation
stages.description: White flowers turn pink and fall off, leaving bolls. Keep pests (bollworm) monitored closely.

stages.title: Boll Bursting
stages.description: Bolls split open revealing white cotton fibers. Suspend irrigation to allow drying.

stages.title: Picking & Harvesting
stages.description: Perform handpicking of clean dry cotton. Avoid picking damp or leaf-mixed bolls.

stages.title: Seedling Planting
stages.description: Plant selected 9-12 month old seedlings in 1m x 1m x 1m pits filled with topsoil, organic manure, and sand.

stages.title: Young Palm Care
stages.description: Provide regular watering during dry seasons. Mulch basin to retain moisture. Spray against red palm weevil.

stages.title: Annual Manuring
stages.description: Apply organic compost, neem cake, and recommended chemical NPK dose in the circular basin.

stages.title: Flowering & Fruit Set
stages.description: Infestation monitoring. Regular fertilizer application continues. First inflorescence appears around year 4-5.

stages.title: Harvesting Cycle
stages.description: Harvest mature coconuts every 45-60 days. Select nuts based on brown husk maturity markers.

stages.title: Sowing & Transplanting
stages.description: Sow in bags, transplant healthy seedlings after 45 days into pits with compost.

stages.title: Establishment Phase
stages.description: Keep base weed-free. Water daily. Apply light nitrogen and phosphorus.

stages.title: Flowering & Sex Determination
stages.description: Identify male/female plants. Maintain 1 male palm per 10 female palms. Spray boron.

stages.title: Fruit Development
stages.description: Thin out crowded fruits. Support heavy trunks. Water heavily during dry periods.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when skin starts turning yellow starting from the base of the fruit.

stages.title: Sapling Planting
stages.description: Plant in well-drained loamy soil. Leave bud joint 10cm above soil line.

stages.title: Irrigation & Mulching
stages.description: Mulch basin with leaf litter. Apply drip irrigation to avoid water logging.

stages.title: Pruning & Training
stages.description: Remove water sprouts, dead shoots, and lower rootstock growth.

stages.title: Blossom Management
stages.description: Apply balanced micronutrients (zinc, iron). Perform light pruning after harvest.

stages.title: Harvest Cycle
stages.description: Pick fruits individually when skin turns orange-yellow and skin feels firm.

stages.title: Planting & Training
stages.description: Plant bare-root or container-grown trees in late winter. Secure support trellis.

stages.title: Spring Budbreak
stages.description: Monitor for powdery mildew. Apply preventive copper spray. Clear weeds.

stages.title: Fruit Thinning
stages.description: Thin out clusters to 1 apple per cluster to secure size and tree health.

stages.title: Pre-harvest Care
stages.description: Protect canopy from birds. Stop nitrogen. Harvest when seeds inside turn dark brown.

stages.title: Winter Pruning
stages.description: Prune during dormancy to open center and allow sunlight penetration.

stages.title: Direct Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds on raised beds. Keep soil warm and moist.

stages.title: Vining & Weeding
stages.description: Perform weeding. Mulch vines with straw. Guide vines along the bed.

stages.title: Flowering & Pollination
stages.description: Introduce honeybees if needed. Restrict overhead watering to prevent flower drop.

stages.title: Netting Stage
stages.description: Nets form on the rind. Apply potash. Keep watering consistent but not excessive.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest at 'full-slip' stage when the stem detaches easily from the fruit.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow in sandy loam mounds. Space plants 2 meters apart.

stages.title: Vine Spreading
stages.description: Irrigate deeply. Avoid watering foliage to prevent downy mildew.

stages.title: Fruit Set
stages.description: Select 2-3 main fruits per vine and remove others. Place straw under developing melons.

stages.title: Sizing & Potash
stages.description: High water demand. Apply potash fertilizer to increase sugar content.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when underside turns creamy yellow and tendrils near fruit dry up.

stages.title: Trellising & Planting
stages.description: Plant rootstocks near trellises. Tie main cane to support wire.

stages.title: Shoot Thinning
stages.description: Thin vegetative shoots to keep canopy open. Apply copper oxychloride.

stages.title: Pruning & Training
stages.description: Prune spurs leaving 2-4 buds. Secure healthy trunks.

stages.title: Veraison (Color Change)
stages.description: Grapes soften and turn purple/yellow. Restrict watering to concentrate sugars.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Test sugar levels (Brix). Harvest bunches with sharp shears during cool mornings.

stages.title: Grafted Sapling Planting
stages.description: Plant grafts in 1m pits with compost and rock phosphate. Stake seedling.

stages.title: Training young plants
stages.description: Prune shoots below 1m to establish strong main trunk canopy framework.

stages.title: Watering & Care
stages.description: Irrigate weekly during dry spells. Mulch basin. Spray neem oil against hoppers.

stages.title: Flowering & Fruit Set
stages.description: First blooms appear. Spray fungicide before flower opening to control anthracnose.

stages.title: Harvest Cycle
stages.description: Harvest fruits with pedicel attached when shoulder swells and color turns pale green.

stages.title: Sucker Planting
stages.description: Plant healthy sword suckers in deep pits. Incorporate cow dung manure.

stages.title: Desuckering & Weeding
stages.description: Keep only one follower sucker with parent plant. Apply heavy nitrogen dose.

stages.title: Earthing Up
stages.description: Heap soil around the stem base to prevent lodging. Maintain soil moisture.

stages.title: Bunch Emergence
stages.description: Bunch emerges from crown. Support stem with bamboo props. Denavel male bud.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest bunch when ridges on fingers turn round and color turns light green.

stages.title: Planting Cuttings
stages.description: Plant rooted cuttings in well-drained soils. Shape into multi-stem palm.

stages.title: Pruning & Training
stages.description: Remove suckers regularly. Keep 3-4 main branches on the plant.

stages.title: Bahar Treatment
stages.description: Withhold water for 30 days to induce dormancy, then prune and irrigate heavily.

stages.title: Flowering & Fruit Bagging
stages.description: Bag fruits with paper/bags to prevent butterfly infestation. Apply potash.

stages.title: Harvest Cycle
stages.description: Harvest when rind turns yellow-red and metallic sound is produced upon tapping.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow in rows with 25cm spacing. Seed inoculation with Rhizobium is highly recommended.

stages.title: Weeding & Irrigation
stages.description: Perform first weeding. Apply light irrigation if winter rainfall fails.

stages.title: Podding Phase
stages.description: Pods begin to form. Inspect crop for aphid vectors and wilt disease.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when plants turn yellow and pods produce rattling sound when shaken.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds at 3-4 cm depth. Seed treatment with Trichoderma is recommended.

stages.title: Thinning & Weeding
stages.description: Maintain plant spacing of 10 cm. Apply post-emergence herbicide if needed.

stages.title: Flowering & Podding
stages.description: Critical water phase. Ensure moisture. Monitor for whiteflies carrying YMV.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when pods turn dark brown/black. Sun-dry threshing to extract seeds.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow in rows. Apply light starter nitrogen along with phosphate.

stages.title: Weeding
stages.description: Keep weed-free. Perform manual hoeing. Irrigate if soil dries out.

stages.title: Peak Flowering
stages.description: Ensure moisture. Protect flowers from thrips. Apply potassium sulfate spray.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest pods in 2-3 pickings as they ripen and turn black.

stages.title: Dry Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds directly in sandy arid soils at the onset of monsoon.

stages.title: Weeding & Spacing
stages.description: Provide light weeding. Extremely drought resistant, restrict irrigation.

stages.title: Flowering & Pod Set
stages.description: Keep crop protected from pod borer larvae. Avoid waterlogging at all costs.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest plants when pods dry up. Dry on threshing yard and winnow.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds in warm loamy soil. Rhizobium inoculant is recommended.

stages.title: Staking & Weeding
stages.description: Provide support stakes for climbing varieties. Keep soil weed-free.

stages.title: Flowering & Podding
stages.description: Regular watering. Apply phosphorus and potassium. Monitor for anthracnose.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when pods turn dry and brittle. Shell seeds and store at low moisture.

stages.title: Sowing & Intercropping
stages.description: Sow with wide spacing. Often intercropped with sorghum or pearl millet.

stages.title: Vegetative Growth
stages.description: Slow early growth. Keep weeds down. Apply organic compost and phosphate.

stages.title: Branching & Canopy
stages.description: Deep taproot secures moisture. Monitor for wilt disease and leaf rollers.

stages.title: Flowering & Pod formation
stages.description: Spray neem extract against pod borer complex. Keep soil slightly moist.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Cut entire plants when 80% pods turn brown. Stack to dry, then thresh.

stages.title: Sowing
stages.description: Sow seeds deep (8-10 cm) to protect against wilt disease.

stages.title: Nipping & Weeding
stages.description: Nip off top vegetative buds to promote branching. Perform first weeding.

stages.title: Flowering & Podding
stages.description: Do not irrigate during peak flowering. Protect pods from pod borer larvae.

stages.title: Harvesting
stages.description: Harvest when leaves turn yellow and drop off. Dry and thresh.

stages.title: Pit Prep & Planting
stages.description: Plant 1-year-old healthy nursery seedlings under shade trees with compost.

stages.title: Shade & Weed Control
stages.description: Maintain 2-tier shade canopy trees. Slash weeds regularly. Mulch plant base.

stages.title: Training & Pruning
stages.description: Prune main stem at 1.5m to facilitate lateral primary branch growth.

stages.title: Blossom Shower & Harvest
stages.description: Irrigate to trigger uniform blossom. Harvest ripe red cherries in pickings.

stages.title: Processing
stages.description: Pulp the harvested cherries, ferment for 24-36 hours, wash and sun-dry.
